item.title: Black Skin, Metal Masks
item.description: The last thing to fit was the mask. Would it conform to my twisted features in comfort? (?, Operation:Doomsday) It is seldom remarked that masks are absent from Frantz Fanon’s Black Skin, White Masks. Other than the title, the word ‘masque’ is used twice in the original French, both times to refer to the masking of something, and is duly rendered as ‘conceal’ and ‘closing our eyes to’ in English translations.
